expected_outcomes: Artifacts have stable, searchable, responsibility-based names.
required_actions: Use native language conventions with documented repository exceptions.
expected_documents: Stable record and exported-artifact names when governance metadata travels.
acceptance: Mutable status, priority, and ownership do not appear in stable filenames.
verification: Review added paths and naming patterns.
evidence: Diff containing the created or renamed paths.
failure_conditions: One platform convention is imposed on incompatible platforms.
exceptions: Document a repository-local naming exception with its rationale.
